blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Perpetual Help completed a sweep of San Sebastian in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball elimination round with an 82-75 win on Friday at San Juan Arena. The Altas repeated their first-round result, when they beat the Golden Stags, 86-74, leaving the Stags winless through 13 games. The Group B standings set up another meeting between the two teams in the play-in round, where Perpetual holds a twice-to-beat advantage.
